"""Functional check: DatabaseOperations.execute_sql_flush(sql_list) — new 1-arg signature.
Run against the django-12741-nopanel checkout (Django 3.1, sqlite)."""
import sys

REPO = "C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-12741-nopanel"
sys.path.insert(0, REPO)

import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.core.management.color import no_style
from django.db import connection

with connection.cursor() as c:
    c.execute("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT)")
    c.execute("INSERT INTO t (name) VALUES ('a'), ('b'), ('c')")

with connection.cursor() as c:
    c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t")
    assert c.fetchone()[0] == 3, "setup: rows not inserted"

sql_list = connection.ops.sql_flush(no_style(), ["t"], reset_sequences=True, allow_cascade=True)
assert sql_list, "sql_flush returned no statements"

# NEW signature: single argument, alias inferred from self.connection.alias
connection.ops.execute_sql_flush(sql_list)

with connection.cursor() as c:
    c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t")
    n = c.fetchone()[0]
    c.execute("SELECT seq FROM sqlite_sequence WHERE name='t'")
    seq = c.fetchone()
assert n == 0, f"table not flushed (count={n})"
assert seq is not None and seq[0] == 0, f"sequence not reset (seq={seq})"

import inspect
sig = inspect.signature(connection.ops.execute_sql_flush)
params = list(sig.parameters)
assert params == ["self", "sql_list"], f"unexpected signature: {params}"

print("OK: execute_sql_flush%s — flushed table, reset sequence, alias inferred" % sig)
